bignews.title: Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party completely sold out for 2026
bignews.body: Every date of the Magic Kingdom after-hours holiday event has sold through just one week into the season. The separately ticketed event runs select nights through December.

parkioInsight.text: With the party sold out, regular park hours tend to end earlier on event nights. Plan to shift to EPCOT or another park by mid-afternoon on party dates to maximize your day.

bignews.title: Fantastic Four character meet location revealed at Avengers Campus
bignews.body: A mobile laboratory set has been installed in Avengers Campus at Disney California Adventure, preparing for the Fantastic Four's first guest appearances. The superhero team will meet visitors in the newly revealed bay door area.

parkioInsight.text: New character debuts usually draw long waits in the first few weeks. Arriving at rope drop and heading straight to Avengers Campus often gives you the shortest queue before word spreads.

bignews.title: Lightning Lane Premier Pass at Magic Kingdom sells out at $479 price point
bignews.body: The first date priced at the new $479 ceiling for Magic Kingdom's skip-the-line product has sold through. November 23 is now unavailable, with other high-price dates expected to follow.

parkioInsight.text: Sellouts at premium pricing usually signal heavy attendance. Standby waits on November 23 may climb above average; consider starting your day at a different park if flexibility allows.

topstories.title: Orlando International Airport issues brief ground stop
topstories.body: The airport serving Walt Disney World issued a temporary ground stop two days after a separate nationwide incident. Operations have since resumed to normal schedules.

parkioInsight.text: If you're flying today, check your airline app for real-time gate updates. Arriving at the airport 30 minutes earlier than usual may help absorb any residual delays.

topstories.title: Star Wars Life Day merchandise launches November 17 at parks and Disney Store
topstories.body: New products celebrating the Wookiee holiday debut Tuesday across Disney retail locations. The collection ties to the 1978 Star Wars Holiday Special tradition.

parkioInsight.text: Limited-edition Star Wars drops tend to move quickly at Tatooine Traders in Hollywood Studios and Star Trader at Disneyland. Visiting these shops within the first two hours of park open usually improves your odds.

topstories.title: Four Disneyland Paris attractions close for January refurbishment
topstories.body: Beginning January 4, 2027, La Tanière du Dragon walkthrough and three other park experiences will shut down for maintenance. The dragon den is unique to the Paris resort.

parkioInsight.text: If Disneyland Paris is on your 2027 calendar, visiting before early January lets you experience all four attractions before they go dark. Book by mid-December to lock in pre-closure dates.

topstories.title: Napa Rose at Disneyland adds à la carte menu alongside prix fixe
topstories.body: The Grand Californian's signature restaurant reversed its prix-fixe-only policy following guest feedback. Diners can now order individual courses instead of the full tasting menu.

parkioInsight.text: À la carte dining lets you control both portion and price. Reservations for Napa Rose often open up same-day around 3pm as guests adjust plans; check the app mid-afternoon.

topstories.title: Tropical Americas permit extended to late 2027 at Animal Kingdom
topstories.body: Imagineering has pushed back paperwork deadlines for the new land, suggesting the Encanto-themed attraction may open later than initially signaled. Construction photos show ongoing work.

parkioInsight.text: If you're planning a 2027 trip around the new land, holding off on booking until spring may give you clearer opening dates. Construction noise near DinoLand tends to peak mid-morning; visit that area early or late in the day.

topstories.title: Rainforest Cafe at Disneyland Paris closes permanently
topstories.body: The Disney Village location served its final guests and shut down November 15. Only two Rainforest Cafe restaurants remain at Walt Disney World, plus one at Tokyo Disney.

parkioInsight.text: The two Walt Disney World Rainforest Cafe locations—Animal Kingdom and Disney Springs—may see heavier traffic as the brand shrinks globally. Reservations or off-peak dining windows around 3pm usually reduce waits.

topstories.title: Holiday DVC member merchandise arrives at Disneyland Resort
topstories.body: Exclusive items for Disney Vacation Club members featuring Mickey, Minnie, and Pluto in seasonal designs are now on shelves. A train-themed mug with lid is priced at $29.99.

parkioInsight.text: DVC exclusives tend to sell through quickly during the holidays. If you're a member, visiting the DVC lounge or resort gift shops before mid-morning usually improves availability.

icymi.title: Disney Springs Cast Member costumes refreshed
icymi.body: New uniforms have been introduced for select Cast Members working in the shopping and dining district. The updated look rolled out quietly this week.

icymi.title: 42 Disney World restaurant menus updated this week
icymi.body: Menu adjustments went live across dozens of dining locations, including pricing and item changes. The updates span quick-service and table-service venues resort-wide.

icymi.title: Lucasfilm confirms 2027 Star Wars theatrical releases
icymi.body: The studio announced its major 2027 lineup, including the return of Mark Hamill's Luke Skywalker in a 1977 re-release. The 50th-anniversary celebration kicks off in January.

spotlight.title: Believe in Holiday Magic fireworks return to Disneyland
spotlight.body: The seasonal nighttime spectacular is running nightly at 9:30pm through early January. The show blends classic holiday songs with projections on Sleeping Beauty's Winter Castle and pyrotechnics above Main Street.

parkioInsight.text: Main Street and the hub fill up 45 minutes before showtime on weekends. Staking out a spot near the flag pole or by the train station around 8:45pm usually secures a clear view without the longest waits.
